title: Secret fe panel
script:
-- Secret FE - Bütünleşik Tam Sürüm (Console Eklendi, Yörsan Kaldırıldı)
local coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

if coreGui:FindFirstChild("SecretFE") then 
    coreGui["SecretFE"]:Destroy() 
end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", coreGui)
screenGui.Name = "SecretFE"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", screenGui)
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 550, 0, 360)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -275, 0.5, -180)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", mainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- Üst Bar
local topBar = Instance.new("Frame", mainFrame)
topBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30); topBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30); topBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", topBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", topBar); title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0); title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0); title.Text = "Secret FE"; title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); title.BackgroundTransparency = 1; title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold; title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local minBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", topBar); minBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 1, 0); minBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 0); minBtn.Text = "-"; minBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50); minBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", topBar); closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 1, 0); closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 0); closeBtn.Text = "X"; closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50); closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)

-- Sekmeler
local leftMenu = Instance.new("Frame", mainFrame); leftMenu.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 1, -30); leftMenu.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30); leftMenu.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
local contentHolder = Instance.new("Frame", mainFrame); contentHolder.Size = UDim2.new(0.75, 0, 1, -30); contentHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0, 30); contentHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local execFrame = Instance.new("Frame", contentHolder); execFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); execFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
local toolFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", contentHolder); toolFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); toolFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1; toolFrame.Visible = false; toolFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,1.5,0)
local backdoorFrame = Instance.new("Frame", contentHolder); backdoorFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); backdoorFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1; backdoorFrame.Visible = false
local scriptFrame = Instance.new("Frame", contentHolder); scriptFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); scriptFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1; scriptFrame.Visible = false
local consoleFrame = Instance.new("Frame", contentHolder); consoleFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); consoleFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1; consoleFrame.Visible = false

-- Executor İçeriği
local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox", execFrame); textBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.6, 0); textBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.05, 0); textBox.PlaceholderText = "Kod..."; textBox.MultiLine = true
local execBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", execFrame); execBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0, 30); execBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.7, 0); execBtn.Text = "Execute"
local clearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", execFrame); clearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0, 30); clearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0.7, 0); clearBtn.Text = "Clear"
local loadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", execFrame); loadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0, 30); loadBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0.7, 0); loadBtn.Text = "Load Ligma"

-- F3X / Admin (Protokidd Dahil)
local c00lBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", toolFrame); c00lBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30); c00lBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.02, 0); c00lBtn.Text = "c00lgui"
local k00pBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", toolFrame); k00pBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30); k00pBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.12, 0); k00pBtn.Text = "k00pgui v8"
local marioBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", toolFrame); marioBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30); marioBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.22, 0); marioBtn.Text = "Mario F3X"
local pelusoBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", toolFrame); pelusoBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30); pelusoBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.32, 0); pelusoBtn.Text = "Peluso Private F3X"
local spamBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", toolFrame); spamBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30); spamBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.42, 0); spamBtn.Text = "Decal Spam"
local protoV2Btn = Instance.new("TextButton", toolFrame); protoV2Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30); protoV2Btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.52, 0); protoV2Btn.Text = "Protokidd GUI V2"
local feBypassBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", toolFrame); feBypassBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30); feBypassBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.62, 0); feBypassBtn.Text = "FE Bypass"
local c00lRemakeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", toolFrame); c00lRemakeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30); c00lRemakeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.72, 0); c00lRemakeBtn.Text = "c00lgui F3X Remake"
local hdAdminBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", toolFrame); hdAdminBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30); hdAdminBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.82, 0); hdAdminBtn.Text = "HD Admin FE Bypass"

-- Backdoors & Scripts
local lalolBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", backdoorFrame); lalolBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 40); lalolBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.2, 0); lalolBtn.Text = "LALOL Hub"
local flyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", scriptFrame); flyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 35); flyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.1, 0); flyBtn.Text = "Fly V3 X"

-- Console İçeriği
local consoleBox = Instance.new("TextBox", consoleFrame); consoleBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.75, 0); consoleBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.05, 0); consoleBox.PlaceholderText = "Console çıktıları ve loglar burada görünür..."; consoleBox.MultiLine = true; consoleBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false; consoleBox.TextEditable = false
local clearConsoleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", consoleFrame); clearConsoleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 30); clearConsoleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.83, 0); clearConsoleBtn.Text = "Clear Console"

-- Menü Butonları
local tabExec = Instance.new("TextButton", leftMenu); tabExec.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35); tabExec.Text = "Executor"
local tabTool = Instance.new("TextButton", leftMenu); tabTool.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35); tabTool.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35); tabTool.Text = "F3X / Admin"
local tabBackdoor = Instance.new("TextButton", leftMenu); tabBackdoor.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 70); tabBackdoor.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35); tabBackdoor.Text = "Backdoors"
local tabScript = Instance.new("TextButton", leftMenu); tabScript.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 105); tabScript.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35); tabScript.Text = "Scripts"
local tabConsole = Instance.new("TextButton", leftMenu); tabConsole.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 140); tabConsole.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35); tabConsole.Text = "Console"

-- Stil
for _, gui in ipairs(contentHolder:GetDescendants()) do if gui:IsA("TextButton") then gui.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55); gui.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); Instance.new("UICorner", gui).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4) end end

-- Mantık
local function hideAll() execFrame.Visible = false; toolFrame.Visible = false; backdoorFrame.Visible = false; scriptFrame.Visible = false; consoleFrame.Visible = false end
tabExec.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() hideAll(); execFrame.Visible = true end)
tabTool.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() hideAll(); toolFrame.Visible = true end)
tabBackdoor.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() hideAll(); backdoorFrame.Visible = true end)
tabScript.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() hideAll(); scriptFrame.Visible = true end)
tabConsole.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() hideAll(); consoleFrame.Visible = true end)

local function logMessage(msg)
    consoleBox.Text = consoleBox.Text .. "\n" .. tostring(msg)
    consoleBox.CursorPosition = #consoleBox.Text + 1
end

game:GetService("LogService").MessageOut:Connect(function(msg, msgType)
    logMessage("[" .. tostring(msgType) .. "] " .. msg)
end)

local function run(url) 
    pcall(function() 
        logMessage("Çalıştırılıyor: " .. url)
        loadstring(game:HttpGet(url))() 
    end) 
end

-- Butonlar
execBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    local success, err = pcall(function() 
        loadstring(textBox.Text)() 
    end)
    if success then
        logMessage("Kod başarıyla çalıştırıldı.")
    else
        logMessage("Hata: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end)

clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() textBox.Text = "" end)
clearConsoleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() consoleBox.Text = "" end)
loadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-project-ligma-logo-240133") end)

c00lBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-C00LGUI-F3X-LEAK-BY-TEAM-IM-ENTTY98-241173") end)
k00pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-k00pgui-v8-F3X-EDITON-52670") end)
marioBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Mario-f3x-239084") end)
pelusoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Peluso-private-f3x-LEAKED-238991") end)
spamBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-protokidd-f3x-texture-spam-48295") end)
protoV2Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-protokidd-gui-f3x-v2-3-57301") end)
feBypassBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-protokidd-gui-fe-bypass-on-f3x-and-free-admin-games-58188") end)
c00lRemakeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-c00lgui-f3x-remake-by-protokidd-48324") end)
hdAdminBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-protokidd-f3x-free-hd-admin-fe-bypass-gui-btools-47542") end)
lalolBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-LALOL-Hub-Backdoor-158177") end)
flyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() run("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Fly-V3-X-132770") end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() screenGui:Destroy() end)
minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local isMin = (mainFrame.Size.Y.Offset == 30)
    mainFrame.Size = isMin and UDim2.new(0, 550, 0, 360) or UDim2.new(0, 550, 0, 30)
    leftMenu.Visible = isMin; contentHolder.Visible = isMin
    minBtn.Text = isMin and "-" or "+"
end)
